description: Nondisclosure agreement legal reference covering confidentiality duties, exclusions, permissible disclosures, compelled disclosure, and remedies.

obligations.title: Define Confidential Information
obligations.description: Clearly define what constitutes Confidential Information and ensure the definition aligns with the parties' permitted purposes.

obligations.title: Exclusions and Carve-Outs
obligations.description: Exclude information that is publicly available, already known, or independently developed without use of the Confidential Information.

obligations.title: Return/Destruction of Materials
obligations.description: Require prompt return or destruction of Confidential Information upon termination or written request, including certification where appropriate.

obligations.title: Remedies for Breach
obligations.description: Provide that breaches may cause irreparable harm and allow equitable relief, subject to standard legal limitations.
